Such keys on any other object (prior members, __context__/__cause__ chains, objects from earlier calls, entries written by callback code) are never a report. Module guarantee: a round writes nothing unless no origin occurred since its snapshot; before writing it removes both keys from every prior member and from E; so after a successful attachment no prior member carries either key and E carries only this call's entries.
